prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: Historians of the fishery now regard the price floor as the state's clearest ______.

worlds.passage: In 1974, one small coastal state set a minimum price that dealers had to pay its fishers for lobster. At the time, dock prices were high and the floor almost never came into play, and lawmakers let it lapse in 1980, a few years after a state court had upheld it. Twenty years later, when clam and scallop dealers challenged new price floors for those fisheries, the state's lawyers won by pointing the judges to that earlier ruling. Historians of the fishery now regard the price floor as the state's clearest ______.
worlds.explanation: Later lawyers won new cases by relying on the ruling that upheld the lobster floor, so it was the state's clearest "precedent." "Pledge" fails because lawmakers let it lapse in 1980, which no lasting promise would allow. "Remedy" fails because prices were high and the floor almost never came into play, and "overreach" fails because a court upheld it.

pledge.why: a measure allowed to lapse was no standing commitment

remedy.why: there was no problem for it to cure

overreach.quote: a state court had upheld it
overreach.why: an upheld rule did not exceed the state's authority

worlds.passage: In 1974, one small coastal state set a minimum price that dealers had to pay its fishers for lobster. A glut the year before had pushed dock prices below what fishers spent on fuel and bait, and boats were being sold for scrap. Two seasons after the floor took effect, the fleet's incomes were back to their old level, lawmakers repealed it without objection in 1977, a court that reviewed it found nothing wrong, and no other fishery has ever been given one. "Precedent" fails because no other fishery has ever been given one. "Pledge" fails because it was repealed once incomes recovered, and "overreach" fails because a reviewing court found nothing wrong.

worlds.passage: In 1974, one small coastal state set a minimum price that dealers had to pay its fishers for lobster. At the time, dock prices were high and the floor almost never came into play, and lawmakers called it a trial to be reviewed after two years. Its text covered every lobster sold in the state, including those caught far offshore in federal waters, and in 1976 a federal judge voided it on that ground; no other fishery has ever been given one. Historians of the fishery now regard the price floor as the state's clearest ______.
worlds.explanation: The floor reached lobsters from federal waters, outside the state's power, and was voided for it, so it was the state's clearest "overreach." "Precedent" fails because no other fishery has ever been given one. "Pledge" fails because lawmakers called it a two-year trial, and "remedy" fails because prices were high, leaving nothing to fix.
